name: Cache
description: Cache artifacts like dependencies and build outputs to improve workflow execution time

path.description: A list of files, directories, and wildcard patterns to cache and restore

key.description: An explicit key for restoring and saving the cache

restore-keys.description: An ordered multiline string listing the prefix-matched keys, that are used for restoring stale cache if no cache hit occurred for key. Note `cache-hit` returns

upload-chunk-size.description: The chunk size used to split up large files during upload, in bytes

enableCrossOsArchive.description: An optional boolean when enabled, allows windows runners to save or restore caches that can be restored or saved respectively on other platforms

fail-on-cache-miss.description: Fail the workflow if cache entry is not found

lookup-only.description: Check if a cache entry exists for the given input(s) (key, restore-keys) without downloading the cache

save-always.description: Run the post step to save the cache even if another step before fails
